parameters.subject: Following up on {{ $json.dealName }}
parameters.message:
Hi there,

I wanted to follow up on {{ $json.dealName }}. It's been a few days since we last connected and I wanted to make sure you had everything you need to move forward.

Is there anything I can help clarify or answer? Happy to jump on a quick 15-min call.

Looking forward to hearing from you!

Best,
[Your Name]

parameters.subject: Still thinking about {{ $json.dealName }}?
parameters.message:
Hi,

I know things get busy. Just wanted to pop back in on {{ $json.dealName }} — we've been working with companies like yours to [key benefit], and I'd hate for timing to be a barrier.

Would it help to schedule a quick call this week? I have openings on [Day] at [Time].

Best,
[Your Name]

parameters.subject: Should I close out {{ $json.dealName }}?
parameters.message:
Hi,

I don't want to keep clogging your inbox, so I'll be brief: I'm going to close out {{ $json.dealName }} on my end this Friday unless I hear back.

If the timing isn't right, no worries at all — I'll make a note to follow up in Q[next quarter]. If you are still interested, just reply to this email and we'll pick up where we left off.

Either way, I appreciate you considering us.

Best,
[Your Name]
